foundry_calls.text: You run your fingers along the sarcophagus seams, dust falling in grey ribbons. The carving of the knight's sword-hilt is worn smoother than the rest — as if touched often.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: Roll Perception to search the sarcophagus.
foundry_calls.speaker: Aria

llm_calls: [Aria]: I search the sarcophagus for hidden compartments.
